scope_note: Five candidate geological hypotheses checked against every executed lane/run card in this checkout on 2026-10-25 (H86..H86M incl. BMR/CNT/LT). 'Untried' = proposed at most in a prior preregistration/followup queue, never executed as a lane here. Not a claim of global novelty across the 92-site fleet or literature. No score projection is made.
ranking_basis: Qualitative expected spatially-blocked HOLDOUT-DTI information gain per implementation cost, weighted by fleet-independence (uniqueness headroom), catalogue-blindness of inputs, and separability of the named mimic. Research-priority ordering only.

common_data_requirement.layers: All five use only native bands of the hash-pinned training_features.tif (sha256 4371c82e...), restored in-sandbox this session via scripts/restore_data.py; band indices verified against src/gems86/io.py BANDS.
common_data_requirement.external_check_optional: USGS ComCat FDSN event service (https://earthquake.usgs.gov/fdsnws/event/1/) is free/official if band 10/16 semantics need an independent rebuild; NOT required for rank-invariant transforms below.

hypotheses.name: Earthquake-lineation anisotropy (structure-tensor coherence of seismicity fields)
hypotheses.physical_signature: Structure-tensor coherence c=(l1-l2)/(l1+l2) of the log-seismicity density (derivative sigma 1.5 px, integration sigma 6 px ~600 m) multiplied by log-density: high only where seismicity is both present and linearly organized at fault-segment scale. Rank transforms make the lane invariant to the bands' unverified units.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: An unmapped active fault under basin fill or young volcanics can host a microseismic lineation while leaving no scarp, magnetic or gravity step for catalogue compilation to see; the catalogue was built from surface mapping, not seismicity alignment.
hypotheses.difference_from_implemented: No executed lane uses bands 10/16 as the primary signal or tests seismicity anisotropy; prior lanes list them only as scalar features inside generic stacks (grep evidence in preregistration). Ranked top in research/H86M_LT_REVIEW.md after BMR was executed negative by the parallel H86M session.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Geothermal-field induced-seismicity clusters and quarry/blast alignments: clusters are radial (low coherence), which the anisotropy gate is designed to reject; residual risk stays named.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Low-to-moderate absolute, highest per cost: signal is sparse/smooth, but it is the only completely fleet-independent physical channel left, so uniqueness headroom is maximal and a paired win vs density-alone would be real information.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low (two FFT-free Gaussian tensor passes on prepared bands; ~minutes CPU).
hypotheses.falsifier: Paired HOLDOUT-DTI difference vs the isotropic-density control (same bands, no coherence) has 95% CI including or below 0, or canary AUC > 0.90.

hypotheses.name: Gravity step-vs-compact-source profile shape test
hypotheses.physical_signature: Cross-strike profile classification: a faulted basement offset is an anti-symmetric step, a dike/compact body a symmetric bump; score = step-template minus bump-template likelihood at frozen scales using the pixel-verified signed derivatives (B11=+d/drow_south, B18=+d/dx_east).
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: Buried basement steps under fill produce the step signature without surface expression; rejecting bump-like sources attacks the dike mimic that vote/tomography lanes cannot separate.
hypotheses.difference_from_implemented: Queued as GSST in registry/followup_hypotheses_20261025.json, never executed; H86F-GZZD/H86H-PSTD use tensor invariants, H86M-BMR a slab residual — none compares competing source-shape templates.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Elongated lithologic contacts and overlapping compact sources forming a linear corridor.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Moderate; gravity is a proven catalogue-correlated channel, but shape separation may mostly re-rank known edges (uniqueness headroom smaller than EQL).
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium (profile extraction along candidate ridges, depth/bandwidth sensitivity).
hypotheses.falsifier: Step-likelihood fails to beat gradient-magnitude control in paired HOLDOUT-DTI CI.

hypotheses.name: Seismicity-to-conductance down-dip phase offset
hypotheses.physical_signature: Directed 200-800 m cross-strike offset, along +grad(depth_to_base), between the seismicity ridge and the shallow conductance (smectite-cap) ridge — the geometric signature of a 50-65 deg dipping permeable fault.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: Blind intrabasin geothermal faults under zero-relief playas have no scarp; the dipping-plane offset between deep seismicity and shallow alteration cap is their predicted fingerprint.
hypotheses.difference_from_implemented: Preregistered-deferred as H86I-2_MTCS in research/H86I_RKSC_PREREGISTRATION.md; never executed. H86M-CNT used conductance neck topology without directed seismic phase offset.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Lateral facies-controlled conductance fronts offset from unrelated seismicity by chance alignment.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Low-moderate; physically specific but the catalogue-hide instrument may under-reward blind-basin geometry (withheld catalogue faults are mapped, hence surface-expressed).
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium (directed cross-correlation along local basement-dip azimuth).
hypotheses.falsifier: Offset score fails vs zero-offset co-location control in paired CI.

hypotheses.name: Spin-2 seismic tensor x conductance-gradient alignment under transtension
hypotheses.physical_signature: Angular concordance between the seismicity structure-tensor orientation and conductance-gradient orientation, weighted by transtensional strain (shear x dilatation).
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: Nascent transtensional accommodation zones (Walker Lane) have minimal throw but aligned seismicity and fluid-conductivity boundaries.
hypotheses.difference_from_implemented: Deferred as H86I-3_SPBT; H86I-SACD used spin-2 Coulomb concordance on potential fields, not seismic-conductance tensor alignment. Overlaps EQL's tensor machinery, hence ranked below it.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Regional strain-aligned joint sets and survey-grid anisotropies shared by both fields.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Low-moderate; two weak fields multiplied can vanish, but a win would be highly specific.
hypotheses.falsifier: Alignment product fails vs either single-field control in paired CI.

hypotheses.name: Transtensional regime-angle gated horsetail splays
hypotheses.physical_signature: Principal strain-rate eigendecomposition (e1,e2)=B8/2 +/- B7 and regime angle atan2(B8,2B7) gating magnetic lineaments into wrench vs extensional horsetail families.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: Transfer zones partition slip onto buried basin-floor strands without range-front scarps.
hypotheses.difference_from_implemented: Preregistered-not-run as H86I-CHTD (research/SESSION_H86I_RLMS_REVIEW_20261025.md); GDSC/WVB used scalar strain only, no regime angle. Ranked last: geodetic bands are very smooth at 100 m grid, limiting dot-level information.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Smooth interpolation artifacts of the GPS strain grid masquerading as corridors.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Low at pixel scale; mostly a regional gate.
hypotheses.falsifier: Regime-gated surface fails vs ungated magnetic-edge control in paired CI.
